item: Feed both paper desks from ONE common normalized live market-data layer (two redundant providers): a single per-universe owner, one authoritative quote per instrument, automatic health-based failover and controlled failback, and no engine coupled to its own broker feed.
instr: Both live providers stay enabled and available as redundant sources. Elect exactly ONE active producer per instrument universe through the health/priority arbiter (DB-backed lease so another process/host is visible). Both engines read the common normalized store and never a broker-specific feed where the common layer already has the data. Never create conflicting price streams for the SAME instrument: one authoritative normalized quote per instrument at a given time. Failover when the active provider goes stale/unavailable; fail back when the preferred provider recovers.
doneWhen: Proven live: both providers registered as producers, exactly one owner per instrument universe, and BOTH the FNF and the Upstox paper desk complete LIVE DATA -> DATABASE -> SIGNAL -> RISK -> PAPER EXECUTION read from the common normalized store, plus a REAL provider outage that demonstrates automatic failover to the healthy provider and controlled failback when the preferred provider recovers (a legitimate NO_TRADE counts as a completed cycle).

grp: GATE 0 - PROTECT THE CURRENT PAPER DESK
goal: Preserve the current real-data, option-only paper system while expanding research.
item: Create and verify a deterministic, provider-independent canonical LIVE tick interpreter that converts FYERS, Upstox, Zerodha and future broker feeds into one validated common market-data schema, preserving source provenance and timestamp semantics, rejecting invalid/untrustworthy data without fabrication, operating without AI involvement, and persisting the canonical representation for all trading desks.
instr: The pipeline is ALWAYS provider raw payload -> provider adapter -> deterministic canonical interpreter -> validation -> canonical persistence -> desk/engine consumption, and it is MANDATORY: there is no off/shadow/on mode for canonical interpretation and no alternate operating path. Broker field names, symbol forms and timestamp units live only in the provider mappers; everything that decides what a tick MEANS (identity, units, timestamps, validity) is a pure deterministic function with no AI. Nothing is defaulted: an absent field stays null and is never replaced by 0, a previous value or a guess. Invalid, impossible, unresolved, future-dated or too-late ticks are rejected with a machine-readable code, counted by code and source, dropped and logged - never repaired, never fabricated and never handed back to broker-specific desk logic. Provenance travels with every canonical tick (source, the broker's own instrument id, payload hash, raw payload) and timestamp SEMANTICS are preserved (a quote time is never treated as a last-trade time). Desks consume the canonical representation, so no engine needs broker-specific interpretation. Measurement/metrics may exist as an internal diagnostic only, with zero effect on production behaviour. Do not add a raw-payload column or raise quote storage/write volume; keep the existing provenance fields.
doneWhen: Proven live on real FYERS and Upstox payloads: both broker feeds pass through the mandatory pipeline (provider raw payload -> adapter -> deterministic canonical interpreter -> validation -> canonical persistence -> desk consumption) with NO operational mode switch, resolve to ONE canonical schema and instrument identity for the same economic tick, preserve source provenance plus broker id, payload hash and timestamp semantics, reject invalid/untrustworthy ticks with counted reason codes without repairing, fabricating or falling back to broker-specific desk logic, produce deterministic AI-free interpretation, and leave the canonical representation persisted in the common store and demonstrably consumed by BOTH the FNF and the Upstox paper desk.
